comments.author: robertpopa22
comments.snippet:
Thanks for the report. This is a **non-fatal** WinForms handle-recreation error in a `ComboBox` during a monitor DPI change (`WmDpiChangedBeforeParent` → `OnFontChanged` → recreate handle) — the app kept running, as the report notes.

You're on **1.80.0 (release 3389)**, which is fairly old; there have been several DPI/per-monitor fixes since. Please update to the latest nightly and let me know if it still happens: https://github.com/robertpopa22/mRemoteNG/releases/tag/nightly
